title: kate-core: shift folds on a same-line insert
summary: A one-edit insert with no newline, space, or tab shifts stored fold ranges. Every other edit still rebuilds the folds from the buffer. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn shift_stored_folds(folds: &mut Vec<kate_text::CharRange>, at: kate_text::Offset, delta: isize)

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add pure_text_insert, shift_stored_folds, shift_bound, and shift_document_folds in workspace.rs. pure_text_insert returns None unless the transaction has one edit, old is empty, and new is not empty. It also returns None when new contains a newline, a carriage return, a space, or a tab. Otherwise it returns the edit start and edit.delta. shift_bound moves an offset when the offset is at or after at. For an exclusive end, it moves the offset only when the offset is after at. A negative result becomes 0. shift_stored_folds applies that rule to every range. A range whose end is at or before its start is dropped. A delta of 0 returns the same ranges. shift_document_folds calls shift_stored_folds on every view of the document. In apply_change, call shift_document_folds when pure_text_insert returns Some. Otherwise call refresh_indent_folds. new_view and replace_from_load still call refresh_indent_folds. Leave view.rs and fold.rs unchanged. The test a_same_line_insert_shifts_the_stored_fold inserts a, newline, two spaces, b, newline, then adds a second view. It then stores the sentinel range 1..2 on both views. It puts the caret at offset 0 and inserts X. Both views then store the range 2..3. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep this change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::a_same_line_insert_shifts_the_stored_fold
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A full rebuild of Xa, newline, two spaces, b, newline stores the range 2..7. After the change both views store the shifted sentinel 2..3. The insert is the single letter X at offset 0.
